name: Awesome Design Skills
summary: Registry of 67 design system skill folders, each with SKILL.md and DESIGN.md, pulled into an AI coding tool by CLI.
description: A curated registry of 67 design skills. Each skill is a folder with SKILL.md (agent instructions: tokens, component rules, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, writing tone, do/don't rules, quality gates) and DESIGN.md (human-readable design intent and rationale). Pull one with the TypeUI CLI, browse the skills/ folders, or copy a file; index.json maps each slug to its path.
contains: 67 design skill folders, each with SKILL.md and DESIGN.md
SKILL.md sections: mission, brand, style foundations, components, accessibility, tone, do/don't rules, quality gates
pull with npx typeui.sh pull <slug>, with provider targeting and --dry-run preview
index.json maps each slug to its skill path
